summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, before the alias block), added the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias, exported the class from monai/losses/__init__.py, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with the binary 2D and empty-class cases. Nothing was run and nothing was committed. Choices: the cross-sample TP and D sums are factorised as alpha_map times the sum over samples of (1 - W) or (2 - W), which equals the full (b, s, v) product; the distance matrix is cast to the probabilities' dtype as well as device; the constructor checks squareness, then converts numpy, then max-normalises. Hand-checked the batch-of-two example (TP 0.8, D 2.4, loss 0.333) but did not execute the tests.
